instruction: Keep going to the previous song on Spotify until you reach a song by Luna Starlight.
notes: The music-player queue is abstracted as a chain of positions q0 (starting cursor) -> q1 -> q2 -> q3 via (prev-of q qp); the Luna Starlight song is assumed three steps back (q3), so the planner unrolls the loop previous_song/show_current_song three times. At runtime the number of iterations is determined by calling previous_song then show_current_song repeatedly until the searched artist_id appears in the current song's artists. previous_song requires the current position to be (inspected) so that each move is preceded by a show_current_song check; q0 is marked inspected in :init because the instruction mandates leaving the starting song. show_current_song records (seen-song-by q artist), a position-keyed fact that never goes stale. complete_task carries two non-API record parameters (reached position and artist) so its precondition equals the goal conditions (cursor on an inspected song whose artist id was looked up); the task asks no question so complete_task is called with no answer. Only spotify.MusicPlayer.cursor_position changes, matching the evaluation.
